title: MCP Server: overview film
description: Connect your AI assistant to TYPO3. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 49 seconds: MCP Server for TYPO3 v14. Every tool, with its rights; Checks that say what to fix; Agent edits wait in a workspace. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Your team works in Claude or Cursor, but TYPO3 content reaches them by copy and paste.
The MCP Server gives Claude, Cursor and Codex structured tools for TYPO3.
Every tool is listed, with badges for reading, writing and administrator-only.
Connection checks test the endpoint, OAuth and workspaces, and say what to do next.
On production, every write lands in a workspace, until an editor publishes it.
MCP Server for TYPO3. Drafts before live content.
